title: docs(runtime): a script action's in-process write into a disabled module is served, per the maintainer's ruling A
body:
Refs #34900
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：没有行为变化。手册补了一段：模块停用后，同一应用里其他模块的按钮脚本仍能往它的表里写数据，模块重新启用后数据都在。
- 为什么做：有人报告这算漏洞，但你 10 月 31 日已裁定应用自己的代码照常读写停用模块，这次把裁决写进手册和设计记录，并用测试钉住。
- 出错会怎样：只改文档和测试，不改运行行为；最坏是文字说得不准，撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：设计记录改了一句话，按规定要人工合并；席位审核通过后请你合并。

## 席位核对

### What changes

- **Handbook** (`content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`): one paragraph after the hooks paragraph. A script action of an enabled package writing into a disabled module's object through `ctx.api` (a script body has no `ctx.engine`) is served (200), and the row appears on re-enable; the module's own `beforeInsert` hooks running on it is stated as today's measured answer, not ruled. `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` is an outward-door answer (REST data plane, by-name reads, `/actions` for the module's own objects, MCP data tools) that in-process code never meets.
- **ADR-0070 D2 amendment** (`docs/adr/0070-package-first-authoring.md:66`): the stale "Not decided here … the question is with the maintainer as decision letter `6538936519`" sentence now records the ruling: letter A, ruling record `6545646924` on #28117. App-authored in-process access (hooks, script action bodies, services, cascades) stays served; no engine-side refusal keyed on caller origin.
- **Pin** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-disable-app-module.test.ts`): a new describe block drives the card's probe. A fifth module (`com.qa.suite.projects`, depending on the app and the orders module) carries a script action `prepare_billing` whose sandboxed body inserts into `qs_order`. With the orders module disabled: the data door answers POST and GET `/data/qs_order` with 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` and no hook runs (control); the action answers 200; the orders module's `beforeInsert` hook saw the row; after re-enable, the row is there and the refused one is not.
- No changeset: no published package's files change (a test file, a docs page and an ADR).

### Review round

Contract review 7016260113 at `b1a24da9`: S1 (a script body has `ctx.api` only; dropped `ctx.engine` from the handbook and the ADR), N1 (the pin docblock calls the `beforeInsert` run measured, not ruled; decision letter 6538936519 lists it as an open gap) and N2 (MCP data tools named among the outward doors) fixed in `211562ef`, prose and a comment only.

### Ruling

This card asked for a refusal. That question was already ruled the other way: maintainer ruling `6545646924` on #28117 (letter A) keeps app-authored in-process access served; options B (refuse app-authored in-process access) and C (refuse every caller) were not taken, and #7557 (A) pins the served-resolver control. A script action's `ctx.api` is that same in-process path (system context). So this PR executes A in docs and a pin; the area closes #34900 citing the ruling.

### Tests and gates

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-disable-app-module.test.ts` on base `94fb8db2d1` plus this diff: Tests 28 passed (28), 27 before plus the new case.
- No ablation: the pin holds the absence of a refusal, so there is no guard to remove.
- Local, exit 0: `check-adr-links`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:pm-prior-rulings`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check-affected-docs`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, runtime typecheck (test layer included).
- `overlap-check --branch=HEAD`: VERDICT clean against origin/main `b68f9ae347`, 0 PR heads.
- Not measured locally: the rest of the derived gate families; CI runs them.

### Routing

Tier H: `docs/adr/**` is human-merged. Seat L2, then the maintainer merges. Noted, not changed (outside the claim's surface): `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` ~:865 names the action door's 404 but not the in-process answer.
